sources.title: Open Development Cambodia, Provision of administrative services of the Ministry of Interior and Ministry of Economy and Finance for biometric passport processing
sources.said: in accordance with the Inter-Ministerial Prakas No.14414 the Provision of Administrative Services of the Ministry of Interior, date 31 December 2016 where the service fee for one general biometric passport was already determined:​ $100 USD (20 days processing), $150 USD (10 days processing), and $200 USD (one day processing).
